scientific_objective: Metrological and structural characterization of paired intra-patient trabecular differences in 2D intraoral periapical radiographs.

excluded_descriptors.reason: Extreme mathematical redundancy with D0 (rho = -0.9979, VIF > 380).
Instability under binarization and lower robustness in F8 permutation test.

locked_policies.outlier_policy: Retain all valid observations in natural scale. Report median, IQR, percentiles. No arbitrary trimming or winsorization.
locked_policies.scaling_policy: Keep features in their natural mathematical units. No global z-scoring or min-max normalization across patients.
locked_policies.digital_scale_nomenclature: Standardized Digital Resampling Grid Target (35 um/px nominal under assumed 150 DPI detector resolution).

statistical_protocol.primary_endpoint: Paired intra-patient structural contrast (crest vs basal) across locked feature set SET_G_LOCKED.
secondary_endpoints: Individual feature paired differences and CIs

one_time_holdout_firewall_rule: After F10 lock, no methodological parameter, preprocessing choice, feature definition, exclusion criterion, statistical endpoint, or configuration may be changed based on any observation from the holdout in F11.
